description:
FILED s473t6a (Opus, 2026-09-17) by #1501 ROUND 8 (t6a), CHECK 2 of
t/op/universal.t.  PRE-EXISTING.  5 blessed rows (the RT66112 block).

The block the rows come from defines its OWN `isa` in two packages, each of
which mutates `@ISA` and then delegates upwards:

    package RT66112::B;
    sub isa { my $self = shift; @RT66112::C::ISA = qw/RT66112::A/;
              return $self->SUPER::isa(@_) }

PROBED and NARROWED (scratch/s473t6a/probes/isa-override.pl) â the override
itself DISPATCHES fine in PCL; what fails is the delegation:

    package P; sub isa { print "P::isa called\n"; $_[0]->SUPER::isa(@_[1..$#_]) }
    package Q; our @ISA = ('P');
    package main;
    print Q->isa('P') ? 1 : 0;

    perl 5.40.3: P::isa called / 1
    PCL        : P::isa called / 0

So `SUPER::isa` from a package with no `@ISA` must fall through to
`UNIVERSAL::isa` and answer perl's truth; PCL's SUPER:: resolution does not
reach UNIVERSAL and the call answers false.  The same question applies to
`SUPER::can` and `SUPER::DOES`.

Rows: t/op/universal.t tests 133, 134, 135, 136, 138 ("modify @ISA in isa
(RT66112::TN isa RT66112::X)"), now carrying this task.  Test 137 (`T5 not isa
D`, the NEGATIVE) passes by accident, since false is what PCL answers anyway.

NOT the same as #1737 (isa/DOES answering perl's FALSE `""`) â that is the
VALUE; this is the LOOKUP.  Read `docs/caller-implementation.md`-era notes on
the CLOS class graph before designing: `p-method-call`'s SUPER:: arm walks the
declared parents, and UNIVERSAL is not one of them.


=== DONE (s516b, as #3280) ===
The same mechanism #3280 found from Type::Tiny: an array argument reached UNIVERSAL::isa (and the SUPER:: built-in arms) UNFLATTENED, so `$self->SUPER::isa(@_)` read the vector as the class.  Fixed in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp (%p-builtin-arg-list).  t/op/universal.t 127/17 -> 132/12 (serial, against a main extraction): the five RT66112 rows pass and left baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv by edit; the snapshot row in baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv edited.
subject: SUPER::isa from a package with no \@ISA does not reach UNIVERSAL::isa and answers false -- 5 rows in t/op/universal.t's RT66112 block
